item.title: A Trip to Remember: Photos from GO! Mexico
item.description: Over a week-long experience, Rams embodied the principles of simple living, solidarity and community that GO! strives to foster. The post A Trip to Remember: Photos from GO! Mexico appeared first on The Observer.

item.title: Student Nonprofit Advocates for Housing Reform
item.description: CivicReset is a nonprofit started by two Fordham sophomores last spring to champion affordable housing reform in New York City and beyond. The post Student Nonprofit Advocates for Housing Reform appeared first on The Observer.
